name: construction-os
description: Construction OS — project workspaces for homeowners, builders/contractors, procurement/logistics, and platform administrators

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@construction-os/types && npm run build --workspace=@construction-os/db && npm run build --workspace=@construction-os/data && npm run build --workspace=@construction-os/api && npm run build --workspace=@construction-os/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace=@construction-os/types && npm run build --workspace=@construction-os/db && npm run build --workspace=@construction-os/data && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
